title: What Drives Informed Trading Before Public Releases? Evidence from Natural Gas Inventory Announcements
summary: Requires historically ranked analysts and median/consensus forecasts with available-at timestamps. Owned NGbars cannot provide them; merges parked NGforecast family.
about: NG inventory forecasts and pre-release trading.
findings: Author-indexed abstract reports Sharpe1.26 for a forecast-conditioned rule; not independently reproduced.
mechanism: Better processing of analysts' forecasts could anticipate news; not proof of leakage.
build_on: Requires historically ranked analysts and median/consensus forecasts with available-at timestamps. Owned NGbars cannot provide them; merges parked NGforecast family.
code_feasibility: Only with forecast vintages and full source rules. Revised storage observations are not forecasts.
source_revision: Gu/Kurov author manuscript indexedMarch25,2018; abstract/source lead only.
